adaptation_notes: The stb port installs the stb headers and a FindStb module but no imported target: the build fragment calls find_package(Stb REQUIRED) and defines stb::image from Stb_INCLUDE_DIR.

The allocation binding's glue compiles stb_image's implementation, so no other translation unit defines STB_IMAGE_IMPLEMENTATION; game code includes <stb_image.h> for the declarations and loads files with am_stb_image_load().
